injuries.name: David Pastrnak
injuries.note: Pastrnak logged 5:50 of ice time Friday before exiting the game. He entered the clash against the Maple Leafs with 11 goals and 32 points through 24 appearances this season. Michael Eyssimont would probably draw into the lineup if Pastrnak isn't an option Sunday versus Vancouver, but obviously, the loss of offense would be extremely difficult for Boston to compensate for. Morgan Geekie and Fraser Minten might be among those who are leaned on more if Boston needs to go a stretch without Pastrnak.

injuries.name: James Hagens
injuries.note: Considering Hagens hasn't been cleared for contact yet, fantasy managers probably shouldn't be expecting him back in the lineup versus the Jets on Wednesday. Still, the 20-year-old's return to practice, even in a limited capacity, is a step in the right direction, which should clear the way for Hagens to return sooner rather than later.

injuries.name: Chris Tanev
injuries.note: out

injuries.name: Dakota Joshua
injuries.note: out

injuries.name: Jack Roslovic
injuries.note: Roslovic is in line to miss his second consecutive game after sustaining his upper-body injury in Saturday's 4-3 loss to the Blue Jackets. Prior to going down, the 29-year-old winger posted nine goals, 23 points, a plus-2 rating, 61 shots on net, 18 hits and 10 blocked shots over 24 appearances this season. If the Maple Leafs aren't able to activate either Kirill Marchenko (lower body) or Colton Sissons (lower body) from injured reserve prior to Friday's game, Toronto will likely have to call up an additional forward for the road test in Boston.

injuries.name: Cole McWard
injuries.note: The Maple Leafs moved McWard onto the injured reserve list Friday. He hasn't picked up a point in two NHL outings this season, but he has earned one shot on net, three blocked shots and one hit.

injuries.name: Nick Blankenburg
injuries.note: Blankenburg is expected to participate in Saturday's morning skate, but it's unclear when he will be ready to return to the lineup. He is currently on injured reserve and hasn't played since Oct. 22. Blankenburg has one goal, six shots on net, six hits and two blocked shots in six appearances this campaign.

injuries.name: Miles Wood
injuries.note: This move was necessary to create cap space for the activation of Dakota Joshua (abdomen) from LTIR. Wood has had no established timeline for a return, but he will be required to miss at least three more games.

injuries.name: Marshall Rifai
injuries.note: ir

injuries.name: Max Domi
injuries.note: There's no timetable for Domi's return after he had complications while undergoing surgery over the summer. The 31-year-old had 12 goals, 36 points and 95 PIM in 80 regular-season appearances with Toronto in 2025-26. Domi will likely serve in a middle-six capacity once he's ready to return.

injuries.name: Cade Webber
injuries.note: ir-nr

injuries.name: Elvis Merzlikins
injuries.note: Less than 24 hours after Merzlikins was traded to the Maple Leafs, a timetable for his return to action has been provided. The 32-year-old backstop had an up and down season in 2025-26, where he posted a 14-11-3 record, a 3.39 GAA and an .883 save percentage across 30 regular-season outings. He won't be rushed into action, as the Leafs new goaltender tandem of Sergei Bobrovsky and Anthony Stolarz are still expected to handle the majority of reps between the pipes this upcoming season. However, when Merzlikins is ready to return, he's the clear No. 3 option in Toronto's organization and could still see some playing time at the NHL level if he isn't sent down to AHL Toronto.
